What Makes a Password Strong?

A strong password typically has:

  • Length: At least 12 characters, but longer is better.
  • Complexity: A mix of uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers, and symbols.
  • Uniqueness: It should not be used for any other account.

Memorizing dozens of such passwords is a difficult task, which is where a generator becomes essential.
